summary: Research Army: the post step now picks one proven hook template (your own best-performing shapes from Greatest Hits and your Vault first, otherwise one of ten shipped templates) and asks Threadify for a compact post (about 300 characters, one fact per line) that ends on an encouraging so-what for the reader. The Auto Plug uses your offer's plain link: a new clean-link step removes utm and other tracking tags because Threadify already tracks every link it posts, and the plug check fails a plug that still carries them. Wording changes you ask for in chat are made exactly and re-checked. From the live THREADIFY-050 demo.
